Eight methods, from CFA through the Franki pile to the micropile. The rigs are simplified; the order and logic of the work phases are real.

The casing supports the wall of the bore right up to concreting, so it can be used safely even in silty soil with a high water content – with diameters of 80–180 cm and lengths of 15–50 (100) m. CFA is built to 22–24 m at most and is not suitable for loose, flowing soil; without support the bore would collapse, and the ground screw is only a 2–4 m element for small loads.
